prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. A full-length documentary photograph of a middle-aged woman taking one step up a flight of worn outdoor steps in a narrow alley on an overcast morning. Catch the moment her forward shoe lands on the next tread as the rear foot pushes off below. A full grocery bag hangs from one hand, the handles taut and the fabric sagging around the weight of its contents. See her from slightly to the side, with her whole body, both shoes, and the edges of both treads clear. Soft cloudy daylight, everyday clothing and quiet alley detail, an unposed moment.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. A candid everyday photograph of a dark-brown-skinned adult handing a handled ceramic teacup to another adult in a teahouse beside a window. Capture the instant both people share the cup: the giver holds the handle, the receiver slides a palm below the base to support it. Frame the two faces and the two hands at the cup together. Choose a slight side angle that shows the handle and the contact underneath; the people attend to one another and the exchange. Soft diffused window light, natural color, lived-in teahouse surroundings.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Chest-up documentary portrait in a sewing room at evening. An elderly white-haired man listens to someone standing beside him and gives a slight smile. His gaze turns toward that person; a glimpse of their shoulder near the frame edge establishes the conversation. From the window, soft blue evening light grazes the side of his face and neck. Warm light from a sewing task lamp falls across his cheek and neck from the other side. Retain the color of his skin through the two lights, with visible pores, fine creases and unretouched texture. A suggestion of the sewing work behind him, candid framing.

Use case: illustration-story. Observational watercolor on textured paper of a young adult sitting on an outdoor bench, bending down to tie the laces of one sneaker with both hands. Capture the small precise action as each hand takes a lace at the same shoe. Slightly oblique side view, the entire seated figure, both shoes and the supporting bench visible. Soft open shade outdoors. Let the same underlying skin color carry from face to forearms to both hands, with gentle shifts in the transparent washes where the light turns. Fresh layered brushwork, recognizable gesture, quiet outdoor surroundings.
